purpose: Correct a proven stale collector inside two immutable images, then run one fresh collector inspection and at most four public capture tasks. No historical replay.

root_cause.launcher_behavior: The reviewed_files hash check exits before launching the App Server when these differ. No model was started.

actions: Two local builds with exactly FROM and COPY; no RUN instruction, image pulls, network or installation. Only the already-reviewed collector replaces the stale file, with root ownership and mode0444; preserve every parent/rollback image.

Resolve and retain each resulting immutable image ID, prepare fresh exact definitions and scope under September25/27 authority, and bind the generated collector review to this parent approval before launch.
One fresh pair inspection with the same11 established probes and actual collector denied-access probe per worker. Preserve failed predecessor and all counters; no automatic retry.

Only after conformance passes, run the same explicit-request pair; only after complete captures and positive bound loading, run the optional pair. Four task turns total, no holdouts, no full comparison, no admission or threshold changes.

Restore the approved proxy stopped and remove only new transient workers/private security snapshots. Retain the two new image tags/IDs, reports, logs, old images, volumes, backups and unrelated user work.
untrusted_execution: Same reviewed Codex binary, launcher, dependencies and exact collector source; the two COPY-only outputs have new image IDs and require this explicit parent approval.
forbidden: New destinations, paid calls or hosted telemetry
New dependency installs or source repairs
More than four task turns or automatic retries
Changing the old comparison or evidence policy
Image/volume/backups removal, activation, release, publication or pushing
approval_record: operator-approval.json with approved=true and review_sha256 equal to this raw file SHA-256
why_new_approval: The preceding exact bundle explicitly prohibited builds and automatic replay. This review permits only two narrowly specified COPY-only derived images plus a fresh gated inspection and the unused four-turn diagnostic allowance.
